title: Native Windows build had to provision a missing Ninja pin
body: The queued tools/vixen-native.sh --direct build build vixen-ninja-release VIXEN and the native-checkout fallback both found the project-local Ninja 1.13.1 pin missing, so build.bat provision downloaded and installed it before any build. Provisioning should be part of the declarative native build contract or preflight.

title: Native Windows witness needed a fresh checkout after direct configure and a diverged lane checkout
body: The queued direct native build failed before compile because build/ninja-release did not exist; the documented configure action then stalled on the WSL-mapped source path and was stopped after 40 minutes without a cache. The checkout fallback then refused the existing /mnt/c/vixen-native/vkhelpers1 because it had diverged, requiring a new VIXEN_NATIVE_ROOT checkout. The native helper should provide a safe documented clean/recreate or auto-configure route for stale/diverged lane checkouts and mapped paths.
